src: P401/P402 mark SH-1 · P104 row SH-3 (verbatim '30"x60" shower pan w/ center drain, no threshold; Delta T24859 supply') · A532 plan 01.1 (5'-0" CLEAR x 2'-6" MIN; seat depth 1'-3" MIN / 1'-4" MAX; entry 1 1/2" and 6 1/2" MAX) · A532.1 views 01/02/03 (HD-5.1 straight rod, HD-14 folding seat, grab bar MIN 33" / MAX 36") · A552 plan 01 kn 5 + kn 6 and finish plan T-02 · G402 detail 02 ACCESSIBLE SHOWER (TA 10 folding seat: seat top 2'-3", 3" MAX gap at wall, 1 1/2" MAX at compartment edge, 'WHEN FOLDED SHALL EXTENDED MAX. 6" FROM THE WALL' [typo as printed]) · G400 detail 07 TA-20.1 SHOWER SEAT AT ACCESSIBLE SHOWER ('17"-19" MAX.' seat)

Flood the pan and hold water for 5 minutes — no ponding away from the drain, nothing escaping past the curbless transition, and a wheelchair-width roll across the transition without a lip.

label: CONFIGURATION B (ROLL-IN SHOWER) - Hand shower and side bar (keyed note 11) — the handset's on/off control MUST be NON-POSITIVE shut-off; hose MIN 59" long and slide-bar top 4'-0 1/2" MAX (G402 det 02)

HAND-HELD SHOWER UNIT REQUIRED TO HAVE ON/OFF CONTROL WITH NON-POSITIVE SHUT OFF.') · G402 detail 02 ACCESSIBLE SHOWER, 'BACK' wall (verbatim 'SHOWER HOSE TO BE MIN. 59" LONG'; slide-bar top 4'-0 1/2" MAX; controls in the hatched zone 2'-3" MAX / 1'-4" MIN off the seat wall) · A533 view 04 keyed note 11 (a TUB elevation, on a different room type — see note)
verifyAtPunch: If the roll-in was built: slide the handset the full length of the bar and confirm it locks at any height and does not slip under the weight of the hose; push and pull on the bar — solid to blocking, no movement. CRITICAL: operate the handset's OWN on/off control and confirm it does NOT fully shut off flow (A530 kn 11 requires NON-POSITIVE shut-off). A handset that shuts flow off dead is the wrong unit even though it looks right on the wall — photograph it and log the model. Confirm the hose reaches the seat position. IF A TUB WAS BUILT INSTEAD: still record present or absent with a photo — A532's tub elevations omit kn 11 but A533's tub elevation carries it, so an absence here is evidence for the open RFI, not yet a defect.
